title: jmap-vtc-sip: SIP/PSTN gateway adapter (on demand)
description: Only if dial-in/dial-out matters: the gateway side of draft-atwood-jmap-vtc-00 (gateway participants, VTCGatewaySignal pendingSignal, gatewayPin) over FreeSWITCH ESL / Asterisk ARI or a SIP trunk such as Twilio. Not a media-streaming adapter; separate from the broadcast hooks. P4 until a deployment asks.
